content.text:
- Count unique declarations, not payments. `source_declaration_id` is unique, while one declaration can have multiple funding entries. [Schema](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/db/migrations/20260915000000_initial.up.sql:19).
- Use `registration_date >= '2024-07-09T00:00:00Z'`. Dates represent Parliament’s registration date from the latest selected register version, stored at midnight UTC. Missing dates cannot be assigned to this term. [Schema contract](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/db/migrations/20260915000000_initial.up.sql:34), [version selection](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_source.rs:179).
- A median declaration count per MP and a median interval answer different questions. For counts, include MPs with zero declarations in the chosen cohort. For intervals, MPs with fewer than two dated declarations have no observed interval. Same-day declarations produce zero-day gaps. Pooling all gaps gives frequent declarers more weight than taking a median per MP first. These are statistical interpretation caveats.
- The member importer requests currently sitting Commons members, while declaration capture processes every stored member ID. Member upserts set current status to true but do not establish a historical term-wide membership cohort. Describe the actual database cohort rather than assuming it covers everyone who served during the term. [Source filter](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_api.rs:47), [capture cohort](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_member.rs:18), [member upsert](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_member.rs:173).
- Capture includes expired interests. The loader updates declarations by source identity rather than storing every published version as a new declaration. Report capture freshness alongside results. `fetched_at` records page capture time, not a new declaration date. [API capture](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_api/declarations.rs:23), [loader](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_loading.rs:824).
